reading.zh: 一个领域一个文件，都跑在同一套 harness 上。最后一组是特例：它测的不是行为，而是契约本身——只要两侧里有一侧与 runner-protocol.schema.json 不一致，它立刻变红。
reading.en: One file per area, all driven by the same harness. The last one is the odd case: it does not test behaviour but the contract itself, so the moment either side drifts from runner-protocol.schema.json it goes red.
